thought.text: Docker is available. Let me check the repo version and network connectivity to Docker Hub.

reasoning_content:
Docker is available. I'll check the network connection, and verify the repository and the available OpenProject images. The guide says to use `openproject/openproject:17` (the all-in-one container). Let me check whether there's internet access to Docker Hub.

First, let me check the git log to confirm which version I'm on, and test the network connection.

action.command: cd /workspace && git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null; cat .ruby-version; grep -m1 version config/initializers/version.rb 2>/dev/null; ls docker/ 2>/dev/null
